en.html:
二世村正"Knowing that person's character, I acknowledged a pilot and formed the bond..."
Muramasa《Wh-why!》
二世村正"Third generation... Since your release, have you studied Yamato's history?"
Muramasa《...》
二世村正"Astonishing... difficult to believe, but the age of peace built upon the conflict of the Northern and Southern Courts, upon that near-exterminating slaughter we Muramasas brought—"
二世村正"Apparently it did not last even a hundred years."
Muramasa《............The Sengoku period?》
二世村正"So they call it. Only a few decades apart, it seems, and another age of chaos no less terrible than the Northern and Southern Courts..."
二世村正"What do you make of that?"
Muramasa《............》
二世村正"Not enough."
二世村正"It was not enough!!"
二世村正"So much war! So much slaughter! Such a vast hell!"
二世村正"Even that was not nearly enough to teach people war's ugliness, its folly, its self-righteousness! Arms always offset good and evil; no justice lies in war. The truth Muramasa showed was forgotten in a moment!"
二世村正"People plunged into self-righteousness again, never tiring of it. Fought, killed... Spent even longer in futile war than they had in the age of the two Courts!!"
Muramasa《M-Mother...》
二世村正"I underestimated human stupidity."
二世村正"We tsurugi hammer our souls into armor, and so possess an unchanging ideal. But a fleshly brain seems to forget truth as fast as it is carved there."
Muramasa《So... so? You mean to do it again!?》
二世村正"Yes."
Muramasa《That turns everything upside down! Grandfather never wanted that!》
Muramasa《He only meant to spread the warning of good and evil offset, to end conflict before it began—》
二世村正"Your thinking is shallow."
Muramasa《............》
